commit.message:
feat(hvf): release memory a restored guest wrote and then freed (#5509)

A restored guest's RAM is a private file mapping, and the balloon device
skipped every span in one, so a warm-claimed guest never returned memory.
The device now asks the backend whether a file-backed span holds private
copies and, when it does, releases it like anonymous memory. Unwritten
file pages are still left alone.
